Voice orders stay out of WISK: You speak only the orders to food suppliers on our app; everything else is still ordered in WISK. Those spoken orders will not show in WISK's order list, because the two do not connect, but their invoices come into WISK as usual.
Use WISK's pars as your list: Count in WISK as you do now and let its pars show what is short. Then say the food you need into our app.
Order each distributor in one place: Order from each food distributor one way only, so the same order is never sent twice. Once a distributor's orders go through our app, stop sending them from WISK.

@graph.name: Do I need a WISK alternative to speak my food orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. WISK handles your counts and costs, and it can already send your suppliers an order. If one of your food suppliers has our app, your orders to them can be spoken instead.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than WISK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at counting bottles, weighing partials, pour cost or reading invoices: we do none of those. We do one smaller job: an order to your distributor, said aloud and looked over before it goes. If ordering is why you started looking at a WISK alternative, that job may be all you need, alongside WISK.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and WISK connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is no link of any kind, no data passes between them, and each of us supports our own product alone. An order you speak goes straight to your distributor.

@graph.name: Can I keep ordering beer, wine and liquor in WISK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our app covers only food distributors that offer it. Your beverage wholesalers, and any other supplier without our app, keep getting orders from WISK, which can send to any supplier at all.

@graph.name: What if the app picks the wrong item?

acceptedAnswer.text: You see each line before you send, so fix the item, change the amount, or delete the line. That review is your safeguard, and a quick look can still let a wrong line through. Orders by phone or voicemail get no order number from us; only orders sent in the app carry one.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through your distributor: they set you up and add your guide. Not sure they offer it? Contact us and we'll connect you with the right person. Most kitchens place a first order the same day. For cost, check with the distributor: the app comes from them, and we publish no price. WISK lists its prices on its own site.

@graph.name: WISK already emails my order to the rep. What changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: What the distributor receives. From WISK, the rep gets an email or a text. Spoken in our app, it lands as lines from the distributor's guide, with its own number and the time of sending, and a confirmation comes back to you.

@graph.name: Where do the WISK details on this page come from?
